kicker: THE WORLD'S NEWS IN ONE PICTURE
footer: As reported by 03:00 UTC, 25 Nov 2026. Sources: Reuters, ABS, SBS, Al Jazeera, Dawn, The Standard, Newsquawk.

lead.head: First foreign astronaut heads to Tiangong
lead.body: Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali lifts off on China's Shenzhou-24 with two Chinese crew for a week-long stay (00:18 GMT, Jiuquan).

stories.head: Iran keeps the Strait of Hormuz shut
stories.body: IRGC says more tankers hit mines; US says main lanes are clear.

stories.head: Houthis hit Riyadh tower again, 11 hurt
stories.body: Second strike in a week; rebels now threaten Saudi ports.

stories.head: Inflation jumps to 4.9%, above forecasts
stories.body: October CPI, up from 4.3%, driven by fuel and power bills.

stories.head: Row in Washington over Nvidia CEO's return
stories.body: Trump says he intervened for Jensen Huang; Democrats eye probe.

stories.head: US readies new tariffs on China, EU and 14 others
stories.body: 'Excess capacity' duties due this week; China faces most.

stories.head: Seoul subway strike averted
stories.body: Wage deal struck early on 25 Nov; lines 1-8 run normally.

stories.head: Putin vows 'inevitable' retaliation
stories.body: After Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian oil refineries.

stories.head: Senegal get their AFCON title back
stories.body: Sport's top court overturns the ruling that crowned Morocco.
